svg.title: Drywall Toolbox logo material specimen using Echelon Argent Oblique
svg.desc: The official Drywall Toolbox logo appears beside desktop and mobile hero scale previews. Silver chrome and cobalt treatments use reusable face gradients, dark contours, a narrow bevel rim and a soft shadow. Letter shapes are Echelon Argent Oblique.
svg.text: Official logo reference · desktop hero scale · mobile headline scale
Approx. 23 px cap height at displayed frame size
Echelon forms · chrome silver / #2255EE logo cobalt · restrained machined edge
MATERIAL TOKENS CALIBRATED AGAINST THE LOGO
Soft silver tonal shift · charcoal contour · narrow bevel rim
Cobalt face anchored to DTB brand blue #2255EE
Material prototype only. Echelon letterforms remain distinct from the logo’s custom DryWall Toolbox lettering.
